items.title_en: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes
items.title_zh: 川普介入後，黃仁勳復職輝達執行長
items.summary_en: Nvidia brought back Jensen Huang as CEO. This happened after US President Trump talked to the company's board. The company's stock price went up after the news.
items.summary_zh: 輝達讓黃仁勳回任執行長。這是美國總統川普與公司董事會溝通後發生的結果。消息傳出後，該公司股價上漲。
items.why_important_en: This shows how political leaders can directly influence major business decisions. It also highlights the high market value of Nvidia.
items.why_important_zh: 這顯示了政治領袖如何直接影響重大商業決策，也凸顯了輝達的高市場價值。

vocab.definition_en: A choice that you make after thinking about it.
vocab.sentence_en: I made a final decision to buy this laptop.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我做出了購買這台筆電的最終決定。

vocab.definition_en: To tell people about something officially.
vocab.sentence_en: The manager will announce the new office hours today.
vocab.sentence_zh: 經理今天會宣布新的辦公時間。

items.title_en: US adds Megaspeed, AI firm at center of Nvidia scandal, to trade blacklist
items.title_zh: 美國將輝達醜聞核心 AI 公司 Megaspeed 列入貿易黑名單
items.summary_en: The US government put a Singapore-based company, Megaspeed, on a trade blacklist. The company is accused of sending AI chips to China. Now, they need special permission to get US goods.
items.summary_zh: 美國政府將總部位於新加坡的 Megaspeed 公司列入貿易黑名單。該公司被指控將 AI 晶片運往中國。現在，他們需要特別許可才能獲得美國商品。
items.why_important_en: This action shows the US government's strict control over AI technology exports. It affects global supply chains.
items.why_important_zh: 此舉顯示了美國政府對 AI 技術出口的嚴格控管，並影響了全球供應鏈。

vocab.sentence_en: Please check the official website for more information.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請查看官方網站以獲取更多資訊。

vocab.definition_en: To get something, especially by effort.
vocab.sentence_en: You need to obtain a permit to park here.
vocab.sentence_zh: 你需要獲得許可證才能在這裡停車。

items.title_en: Ukraine confirms it used naval drones to strike two Russian ships off Libya
items.title_zh: 烏克蘭證實使用海軍無人機襲擊利比亞外海的兩艘俄羅斯船艦
items.summary_en: Ukraine used naval drones to attack two Russian ships near Libya. One of the ships, the Merkury, sank. The operation was launched from a mothership.
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭使用海軍無人機襲擊了利比亞附近的兩艘俄羅斯船艦。其中一艘名為「梅爾庫里號」的船艦沉沒。這次行動是由一艘母艦發起的。
items.why_important_en: This demonstrates the use of new drone technology in modern naval warfare. It shows how drones can change battlefield outcomes.
items.why_important_zh: 這展示了無人機技術在現代海戰中的應用，並顯示了無人機如何改變戰場結果。

vocab.definition_en: To say that something is true.
vocab.sentence_en: Can you confirm your email address for the booking?
vocab.sentence_zh: 你能確認一下預訂用的電子郵件地址嗎？

vocab.definition_en: To use or control a machine or system.
vocab.sentence_en: It is easy to operate this coffee machine.
vocab.sentence_zh: 操作這台咖啡機很容易。

items.title_en: Gisèle Pelicot ‘deeply shocked’ after nude images used to promote book
items.title_zh: 吉賽兒·佩利科對裸照被用於宣傳書籍感到「深感震驚」
items.summary_en: Gisèle Pelicot is upset because her nude photos were used to promote a book without her permission. The book suggests she was involved in her own abuse. She plans to take legal action.
items.summary_zh: 吉賽兒·佩利科感到非常難過，因為她的裸照在未經許可的情況下被用於宣傳一本書。該書暗示她參與了對自己的虐待。她計畫採取法律行動。
items.why_important_en: This raises important questions about privacy and consent in media. It also highlights the ongoing struggle against sexual violence.
items.why_important_zh: 這引發了關於媒體隱私與同意的重要問題，也凸顯了對抗性暴力的持續努力。

vocab.definition_en: To help something to happen or increase.
vocab.sentence_en: The company wants to promote its new product line.
vocab.sentence_zh: 公司想要宣傳他們的新產品系列。

vocab.sentence_en: We need to get some legal advice before signing.
vocab.sentence_zh: 簽署前我們需要尋求一些法律建議。

items.title_en: Butt of the joke: Trump impersonator mocks president at Canada press dinner
items.title_zh: 笑柄：川普模仿者在加拿大媒體晚宴上嘲諷總統
items.summary_en: At a dinner in Canada, a comedian dressed as Donald Trump mocked the US president. The audience of politicians and journalists laughed at the performance. The comedian made fun of Trump's trade policies.
items.summary_zh: 在加拿大的一場晚宴上，一名喜劇演員裝扮成唐納·川普並嘲諷了這位美國總統。現場的政治人物與記者對表演感到好笑。該演員嘲弄了川普的貿易政策。
items.why_important_en: This event shows how political satire is used in public life. It also highlights the tense relationship between some international leaders.
items.why_important_zh: 此活動顯示了政治諷刺在公共生活中的運用，也凸顯了部分國際領袖之間緊張的關係。

vocab.definition_en: To laugh at someone in an unkind way.
vocab.sentence_en: It is not nice to mock people for their mistakes.
vocab.sentence_zh: 因為別人的錯誤而嘲笑他們是不好的。

vocab.definition_en: The act of entertaining people by acting or singing.
vocab.sentence_en: The band gave a great performance last night.
vocab.sentence_zh: 樂團昨晚有很棒的表演。
